releaseNotes.start.label: Let’s go!
releaseNotes.current.recipe.title: Packs reopen exactly as built
releaseNotes.current.recipe.detail: A pack generated by the menu editor or the simple editor reopens with “Edit an audiobook” in the same editor, exactly as you built it, later edits included.
releaseNotes.current.imports.title: Imports from Home
releaseNotes.current.imports.detail: A podcast or YouTube video imported from the Home screen opens in the menu editor with its stories and media. A single YouTube video imports again, and a channel with a custom address can be followed.
releaseNotes.current.assembly.title: Assembling packs
releaseNotes.current.assembly.detail: Assembling from the Home screen works again. The wizard is simpler: you can continue in the menu editor as soon as you pick the packs, or at the sound or image step, and what you have already chosen is kept. Packs can be reordered by drag and drop.
releaseNotes.current.catalogue.title: Catalogue
releaseNotes.current.catalogue.detail: A scan only re-reads new or modified packs. Official covers arrive during the scan, with a clear placeholder while they load. A renamed or moved pack keeps its favourites and data.
releaseNotes.current.checker.title: Pack checker
releaseNotes.current.checker.detail: A clearer, more accurate report: stories properly named and counted, no invented age, an automatic correction is no longer an error, and the volume is fixed as in the editor.
releaseNotes.current.endings.title: End messages and destinations
releaseNotes.current.endings.detail: A folder can be an end destination. End messages play without waiting for OK, as the editor announces, and automatic chaining hides the end message in the tree as well as in the diagram.
releaseNotes.current.lunii.title: Lunii
releaseNotes.current.lunii.detail: Sending several stories no longer fails when the catalogue changes during the copy, an unreadable file on the Lunii no longer blocks removals, and error messages say what really happened.
releaseNotes.current.media.title: Sounds and media
releaseNotes.current.media.detail: An MP3 already in the right format goes to the Lunii without its tags and without re-encoding, an MP3’s cover is copied into the project, and a project only creates the media folder it uses.
releaseNotes.current.editors.title: Editors
releaseNotes.current.editors.detail: A track longer than 19 minutes is no longer cut off, a duplicated folder keeps its navigation, the graph editor only lists missing media that are actually used, and the simulator tells you when the project has changed.
releaseNotes.current.recovery.title: Crash recovery
releaseNotes.current.recovery.detail: An unsaved project is still offered on the Home screen, even after more than 24 hours, and its media are no longer deleted at startup.
releaseNotes.open.label: What’s new
releaseNotes.current.fixes.label: Plus various other fixes and improvements.
